info.title: ProjectX.API
info.description: HTTP API used by the ProjectX Unity client and dedicated game server for authentication and persistent game state.

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token.
Issues a replacement access token for an eligible session.
Adds experience and returns the updated progression.

get.description: Returns a character's inventory and capacity.

post.description: Atomically applies inventory changes and reports when the resulting items do not fit.

get.description: Returns quests assigned to a character.

post.description: Assigns a quest to the authenticated user's character.
Adds progress to an accepted character quest.
Adds event progress or synchronizes a matching collect quest with the current inventory.
Completes a finished quest and returns its reward.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's playable characters.
Returns the selected character's current state.
Returns the latest saved character transform.
Returns active recipes for a crafting profession.

post.description: Registers a dedicated game server session.
Renews an active game server lease.
Creates a short-lived one-time connection ticket for a selected character.
Redeems a ticket and creates a player session.

JWT.description: JWT bearer token returned by the application-user login endpoint.
